# game-icons.net glyphs

Quest objective glyphs, from https://game-icons.net (repository
https://github.com/game-icons/icons), licensed CC BY 3.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

| File | Author | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| radio-tower.svg | Delapouite | mark |
| cardboard-box.svg | Delapouite | plantItem, plantQuestItem |
| magnifying-glass.svg | Lorc | visit (mostly "locate ...") |
| light-backpack.svg | Delapouite | findQuestItem (pick an item up) |
| crosshair.svg | Delapouite | shoot |
| hand.svg | Lorc | useItem |

Unmodified. Each file carries a black 512x512 background square; it is
stripped when the glyph is rasterised (src/ui/QuestGlyphs.cpp).
